PROBE_BUGS_HIT_THIS_SESSION: MEGA is an SPA — goto to the URL already loaded does not repaint. Fixed with an explicit reload(). Without it every click locator waited on a stale DOM and timed out.

`.file-name` ALSO matches MEGA's own chrome placeholders ('examplefilename.png', 'Object 2'). A generic `waitFor('.file-name')` reports success BEFORE the real list paints, so a naive poll exits early and the subsequent click waits forever. This produced two consecutive 8s/10s/20s click timeouts that looked like a bad selector and were actually a bad WAIT.
`process.env` is not defined in dev-browser's QuickJS runtime — a script parameterised by env var dies immediately with a ReferenceError.

Depth-filtering the nav tree by counting treesub_ ancestors returns depth>=1 for every row including root, so ROOTLEVEL came back EMPTY while 46 rows existed. Matching on name was correct; the depth heuristic was the bug.

The grid renders each file as TWO DOM nodes in some views (Swipes showed 8 rows for 4 files; Templates 64 for 32). Raw row counts are DOUBLE the file count. Any count taken from the grid must be deduplicated before it is reported — an unreconciled count here would have overstated the PDF population by exactly 2x.
